deps.edn.reason: The git floors and pins on repositories that are bundled here become local roots so the same namespaces are not loaded twice. The other sections are unchanged. JVM-only Maven dependencies and aliases are removed (dep org.clojure/clojure, dep org.clojure/clojurescript, alias :test reduced to :extra-paths, alias :lint): the official CD/CI path is Amu selfhost and Kotoba native, and any other runner is an oracle that is not part of the package.

nbb.edn.reason: The same git floors as deps.edn are resolved through the bundled libraries by kbb from lib/; the file keeps only the paths.

src/kotoba/sqlite/varint.kotoba.reason: Canonical Kotoba-only SQLite v3 varint codec; introduced for the native selfhost engine under JUN-768.

src/kotoba/sqlite/header.kotoba.reason: Canonical Kotoba-only SQLite v3 header codec and header constructor for the native selfhost engine under JUN-768.

src/kotoba/sqlite/notepad_record.kotoba.reason: Canonical Kotoba-only four-TEXT SQLite record codec for Itonami cron_notepad; introduced under JUN-768.

src/kotoba/sqlite/page.kotoba.reason: Canonical Kotoba-only SQLite v3 B-tree page codec and bounded page constructors for JUN-768.

src/kotoba/sqlite/record.kotoba.reason: Canonical Kotoba-only bounded SQLite v3 record layout decoder for schema discovery; introduced under JUN-768.

src/kotoba/sqlite/schema.kotoba.reason: Canonical Kotoba sqlite_schema table and primary-key autoindex record encoders for JUN-768.

src/kotoba/sqlite/database.kotoba.reason: Canonical Kotoba-only initial SQLite image builder for Itonami cron_notepad under JUN-768.

src/kotoba/sqlite/reader.kotoba.reason: Canonical Kotoba-only SQLite schema/table B-tree reader with bounded overflow materialization, validated job/key lookup, and KNV1 direct value result under JUN-768.
